snippet.title: Toni Island ADventure | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
«Toni Island Adventure» Now Available on Steam!
➡️ https://s.team/a/2908830/

Toni Island Adventure is primarily being developed for the Game Boy Color, offering not just a "retro aesthetic" but a true 8-bit handheld experience.
You play as Toni, a pizza-loving sailor dog stranded on Salamino Island, as he helps quirky locals, solves bite-sized puzzles and dungeons, and battles imaginative bosses to restore harmony to the island. With its chill, cozy tropical vibes and heartwarming narrative, it balances nostalgia with a fresh, modern experience.
